d: Atrium in the suburban palace of the console Manlio. Spacious staircase that introduces to his apartments. Attilia, Licinio from the staircase, Littori and Popolo.
Attilia, Manlio from the ladder, Littori and People.

Internal part of the Temple of Bellona; seats for the Roman Senators and for the Foreign Orators. Littori that guard various entrances of the Temple, from which views of the Capitol and the Tiber. Manlio, Publius and Senators, Indi Regolo and Amilcare. Littori that guard the entrance; follow-up of Africans and People outside the Temple.
Regolo, Publius, Amilcare, indi Attilia, Licinius and People.
Attilia suspended, Amilcare leaving, Barce coming.
Lodges on sight of Rome in the suburban palace for the Carthaginian Ambassadors. Regolo and Publio.
Publius, then Attilia and Barce, then Licinius and Amilcare, one after the other and from different parts.
Earthly room corresponding to gardens, rule, African Guards and then Manlio.

Magnificent porticos on the banks of the Tiber; ships ready in the river for the boarding of Regolo. Bridge that leads to the nearest of those. Numerous people that prevents the passage to the ships. Africans on the same. Littori with the Consul. Manlio and Licinio.
